title: Figure 60: half-symmetry mesh of UFO sphere for 300 MHz radar cross section model
description: ANSYS finite-element mesh plot labeled 'RCS of a Dielectric-coated Metallic Sphere for 300 MHZ UHF,' captioned 'Mesh of 1/2 Symmetry UFO Sphere with 25 Elements per Wavelength.' Hemispherical dome of triangular elements, dated Oct 27 2010. Setup for the BAASS radar cross-section electromagnetic simulation of a spherical UAP.
